name: source-lm
description: Chrome MV3 extension: JSON -> Markdown sources -> upload to Notebook

scripts.package: npm run build && VERSION=$(node -p "require('./manifest.json').version") && rm -f "source-lm-v$VERSION.zip" && zip -r "source-lm-v$VERSION.zip" manifest.json icons dist src/popup/popup.html src/popup/popup.css
